This support can make the transition easier and more positive, which in turn reinforces the moral correctness of the decision. In summary, deciding whether it's right or wrong for someone whose life is all about helping himself and beer to become sober involves evaluating the potential benefits and drawbacks, considering the impact on themselves and others, and respecting their personal autonomy.
